title: Latvian State Scholarships
description: State scholarships for undergraduate (from the second year), master's and doctoral students, as well as researchers, from countries with a bilateral agreement or from a broader eligible list, for study or research at Latvian higher education institutions.
amount: EUR 500 per month (bachelor's and master's) or EUR 670 per month (doctoral and research)

title: University of Latvia Scholarships for International Students
description: Tuition-reduction scholarships and merit awards for international students admitted to a degree programme at Latvia's largest university.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction (varies by faculty and programme)

title: Riga Technical University Scholarships
field: Engineering, IT, architecture, materials science, business
description: Merit-based tuition reductions for international students admitted to an English-taught programme at Latvia's leading technical university.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction based on academic performance

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Latvia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Latvian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
